towers.name: Guard Archer Tower
towers.description: Disciplined marksmen watch over fortified walls.
towers.lore: A watchtower with a roster, a bell and a sergeant. Shifts change at dawn and the arrows never stop.

towers.name: Cannon Bastion
towers.description: Dwarven powder and iron shot, loud and wide.
towers.lore: Dwarven powder packed into kingdom stone. One shot is heard in three valleys and felt in the whole line.

towers.name: Alchemist Tower
towers.description: Flasks of slow-working blight that ignore armor.
towers.lore: A university tower with the windows bricked up. The flasks that leave it keep working long after the lecture.

towers.name: Guard Post
towers.description: A captain barking orders sharpens the whole wall.
towers.lore: A captain, a banner and a voice that carries. Every wall within earshot stands straighter and fires faster.
